qc.label_under_test: the verb 'go' (go, goes, gone, went) as the main verb after a subject or modal, especially in idioms like 'go back', 'go wrong', 'go about', as opposed to synonyms (return, approach) or the noun/game 'Go'

neighbours.label: the verb 'go' (go, went, gone, going), strongest right after a modal, negation or how-question (can't go wrong, how do we go about); other motion verbs in the same slots and the game 'Go' stay quiet
